dedupe_keys.name: fiji evacuation tracking and monitoring cycle 2 site assessment after tropical cyclone winston 2016 iom dtm

description: This dataset holds the second cycle of evacuation centre site assessments carried out in Fiji between 31 May and 21 June 2016, after Tropical Cyclone Winston, by the International Organization for Migration's Displacement Tracking Matrix. Each evacuation site record describes the site, the displaced population it hosted and conditions such as shelter, water, sanitation and access to services, collected as a census of sites. Coverage is the evacuation sites still open in Fiji during that cycle. The sanitised complete dataset is free to download as an Excel file, with an interactive KMZ map, from the Humanitarian Data Exchange. The licence is IOM's own: the materials may be viewed, downloaded and printed for non-commercial use only, without redistribution or derivative works, and must be credited to IOM DTM. Caveats: the data are a single post-disaster cycle, personal data were removed, and the reuse terms restrict sharing of derived products. Simulation uses: calibrating shelter demand and the duration of evacuation centre use after a severe tropical cyclone, and validating evacuation and shelter allocation models for Pacific islands. Related records: the Cambodia evacuation sites (data-cambodia-pursat-oddar-meanchey-evacuation-sites) are another humanitarian shelter list.
